title: Add or edit a location
summary: Set the branch address, time zone, public contacts and initial opening hours.

sections.title: Before you begin
sections.body: You need business-wide settings access. An additional active location also needs available subscription capacity. A location identifies where work happens; it does not automatically assign people or services.

sections.title: Save location details
sections.body:
1. Open **Locations**. Choose **Add location**, or use **Location to edit** for an existing branch.
2. Enter the required **Location name** and **Time zone**.
3. In the address editor, choose a Google suggestion or enter the full address manually. Review the selected address. Add entrance, unit, floor, parking or arrival details when useful.
4. Review **Public phone** and **Public email**. These contacts are optional in the form, but clients need a reliable way to reach your business.
5. For a new location, select working days and enter **Opens** and **Closes**. The closing time must be after opening.
6. If appropriate, select **Primary location · shown first in booking**.
7. Select **Add location** for a new branch, or **Save changes** for an existing one.

sections.title: Make the location usable
sections.body: Check its saved name, address and time zone. Then assign working branches in Team & availability and eligible locations in Services. Use Business setup’s Opening hours for different daily or split hours.

sections.title: Common location questions
sections.body: If **Review location limit** replaces Add location, an authorized billing user must review capacity. If address search is unavailable, use manual entry. Changing a time zone may be blocked by upcoming appointments; review those visits rather than assuming their times will move automatically. Saved appointments retain the address captured for their assigned location.
